## 1.1 REDUCE ENERGY RELATED GHG EMISSIONS BY 51% BY 2030.

Using SEAI 2024 monitoring data, SETU will reduce energy-related CO2 emissions from the 2016-2018 average baseline to meet its 2030 target. Figure 3 below, the SEAI Gap to Target model, shows the level of reductions required from the baseline data to meet 2030 emissions target data through energy reduction.

Figure	3:	 SEAI Gap to Target model showing a reduction of Total CO2 target of 1,739,631.3 kgCO2 (incl. fossil CO2 target = 863,063.7 kgCO2) to meet 2030 targets.

<!-- image -->

To meet the 2030 targets SETU will focus on thermal emission reductions consumed on the University campuses. This involves long term planning for capital investment and ongoing measures, including planned building efficiencies, along with deployment of heat pumps to migrate heating inputs from fossil fuel to nonfossil fuel sources over time. The following projects have been specifically identified as required in order to meet the 2030 targets as set out in Figure 4.

## 4.9  EV CHARGING STATIONS

SETU have installed electric vehicle (EV) charging points across on number of campus locations to facilitate charging EVs both for the University's single electric but also to cater for the increasing numbers of staff, student and visitor with EV's.
